title: Raytheon’s High-Power Microwave Weapon Downs Drones
summary: Cleared Defense Department footage of Raytheon's Phaser high-power microwave weapon bringing down drones during a 2013 live-fire demonstration at Fort Sill. Raytheon says it has halved the payload size and is offering the system for operational use.
why: HN cites it as evidence that microwave and electromagnetic weapons against drones are real and already tested.

quote.text: microwave systems have already been tested
